title: Repeat with a smaller job
summary: Haskell: Repeat with a smaller job. Calculate sumTo 4.
introduction: A recursive function calls itself. This one stops at zero, then adds numbers on the way back.
learningObjectives: Repeat with a smaller job with Haskell

blocks.text: Install GHC. Save one example as lesson.hs and run runghc lesson.hs. Keep any definitions above main in the same file.

blocks.title: Repeat with a smaller job
blocks.code:
sumTo n
  | n <= 0 = 0
  | otherwise = n + sumTo (n - 1)
main = print (sumTo 3)

blocks.text: sumTo 3 adds 3, 2, 1 and 0. The zero case stops recursion.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: A recursive function needs a case that stops.
